goals: Maintain the private Foundation resource pack for Minecraft Java 26.2 without modifying its immutable source archive.
scope: Foundation v7 replaces only the Veiled, Silver Birch, and Wisteria inventory item-model routes with target-textured, Matcha-structured cube-plus-foliage models while preserving their v6 world resources.

exclusions: originals/resourcepacks/Foundation v4.zip and originals/resourcepacks/Matcha-Overlays-v37.zip are immutable and are neither changed nor redistributed.
Block Geometry Extensions, BGE x Bushy Leaves, Mynx Trees Java code, Enderscape Integration Java code, Enderscape Overlays, and unrelated projects are outside this resource-pack consolidation.
No Minecraft test profile is inspected or changed.

dependencies.reason: Supplies the complete immutable v6 base whose non-item resources are retained unchanged.

dependencies.requirement: read-only structural reference for the active Minecraft Oak Leaves item-model chain; no Matcha texture or unrelated asset is redistributed
dependencies.reason: Its minecraft:block/cross_leaves parent provides the inspected central-cube plus four exterior-card topology used by the target-specific v7 item models.
Defines the assets/<namespace>/items/<id>.json item-model selector convention used by the correction.

state.milestone: Foundation v7 repairs the three target inventory previews with Matcha-structured item models while static archive validation passed and runtime testing remains outstanding.

current.summary: Restores cube-plus-bushy foliage inventory previews for Veiled, Silver Birch, and Wisteria Leaves without changing their in-world resources.
